marketing.home-meta-description: Seenaly diagnoses your Meta Ads with evidence: it finds the bottleneck in the creative, the funnel or the offer and names the next test. Start free, no account connection.
marketing.hero-title: Stop guessing why your ads don't sell.
marketing.hero-subtitle: Seenaly reads your Meta Ads account, your funnel and your test history and returns an evidence-backed diagnosis: where the bottleneck is, what to do now and how to know it worked.
marketing.logos-label: Teams that run their traffic on Seenaly
marketing.features-subtitle: Every conclusion rests on a campaign data point, something about your product, or a rule from Meta's documentation.

marketing.feature-2-description: Data is isolated per organization with row-level security enforced in the database — not just filters in the application.

marketing.feature-5-description: AI answers grounded in your own documents and knowledge base, with usage billed per message through credits.
marketing.feature-6-description: Dashboards and reports read real product data, scoped by organization and role — no exports, no stale spreadsheets.

marketing.faq-1-question: Do I need to connect my Meta account?
marketing.faq-1-answer: No. Seenaly starts from your product context and Meta's official knowledge — you can get guidance with no campaign connected. Connecting only enriches the diagnosis once you have data.
marketing.faq-2-question: Does Seenaly publish or manage my campaigns?
marketing.faq-2-answer: No. It analyzes, diagnoses and suggests the next test — the decision and the operation stay with you. It's a decision layer, not autopilot.
marketing.faq-3-question: Is it another automation, like Advantage+?
marketing.faq-3-answer: We don't compete with Meta's automation. Seenaly helps you feed it better: creatives, structure, offer and funnel data Meta can't see on its own.
marketing.faq-4-answer: By credits: each diagnosis spends credits. There's a free plan to start and plans with more credits as your operation grows.
marketing.cta-subtitle: Add your product, get the evidence-backed diagnosis and know the next test — before the day is out.
marketing.about-meta-description: Why we turned the 7am account check every media buyer does by hand into software.
marketing.about-subtitle: Seenaly exists because account diagnosis is daily, repetitive and decisive — exactly the kind of work software should do.
marketing.about-story-p1: Every traffic team starts the day the same way: open Ads Manager, scan yesterday's numbers, guess which changes matter. Once the operation grows past a few accounts, that reading gets shallow — and expensive mistakes hide in the campaigns nobody had time to check.
marketing.about-story-p2: Seenaly does that reading completely, every day, on every account. It flags what a senior buyer would flag and explains the reasoning with numbers, so the human hours go into decisions and creatives — the work that actually moves results.
marketing.about-values-title: Three commitments we do not trade
marketing.about-value-1-description: Every recommendation ships with the data that produced it. If we cannot show the why, we do not show the suggestion.
marketing.about-value-2-description: Seenaly analyzes and recommends; it does not touch campaigns. Changes to your account remain yours to make.
marketing.about-value-3-description: Diagnoses are written so a client can read them — no wall of jargon between the data and the decision.

marketing.privacy-2-body: To provide the service, process payments through our providers, send transactional email and meet legal obligations. We do not sell personal data.
marketing.privacy-3-body: Data is stored with per-organization isolation enforced at the database level, encrypted in transit, with access restricted by role. Audit events are retained append-only.
marketing.privacy-4-body: You can request access, correction, export or deletion of your personal data. Consent records are versioned, and you can review what was accepted and when from your account.
marketing.readout-signal: CPA up 32% — the bottleneck is CPC, not conversion.
marketing.readout-row-3-value: New hook on the top 3 creatives
marketing.pipeline-title: From raw signal to the next action.
marketing.pipeline-1-body: Spend, CTR, frequency, CPA and ROAS by creative and period — respecting the breakdowns the API lets you cross.
marketing.pipeline-2-body: CPA = CPC ÷ post-click conversion. Is the bottleneck before the click (creative, audience) or after (page, offer, checkout)?
marketing.pipeline-3-body: A fixed format, with confidence and a success test. When there isn't enough data, it says so — it never invents a conclusion.
marketing.row-1-title: Every recommendation anchored to your own data.
marketing.row-1-body: “Test new angles” is a banned answer. Seenaly returns diagnosis, evidence, technical basis, action, risk and success test — same format, every time.
marketing.row-2-title: Refresh the creative before you burn budget.
marketing.row-2-body: When CTR drops and frequency climbs, Seenaly marks the turn — and tells you which top creative to refresh first, based on what already worked.
marketing.bento-1-body: Before the click (creative, audience, promise) or after (page, price, checkout). When the problem is outside Meta, it says so plainly.
marketing.bento-2-body: Hypothesis, change, result and conclusion of every test. Over time the AI becomes an expert in your products — and won't re-suggest what you already ruled out.
marketing.bento-3-body: Policies, the learning phase, pixel and CAPI, Advantage+ and relevance diagnostics — the technical foundation of every recommendation.
marketing.bento-4-body: Starts from your product context and official knowledge: which event to optimize, how to structure the first campaign, which offer to test. The Meta account is enrichment, not a prerequisite.
marketing.bento-5-body: Meta's official docs and real data outweigh courses and opinions. The decision knows what to lean on — and what not to.
marketing.row-3-bullet-1: Breaks CPA down: CPC × post-click conversion
marketing.row-3-bullet-2: Says whether it's the page, the price or the checkout
marketing.row-3-bullet-3: Asks for the missing data instead of assuming
marketing.row-4-bullet-1: Hypothesis, change, result and conclusion of every test
marketing.row-4-bullet-2: Never re-suggests an experiment you already ruled out
marketing.row-4-bullet-3: Learns the patterns of your products and offers
